summary: I’ll interpret “a box with a ball in it” as an open-top container holding a ball.
The existing scene has zero gravity; I’ll preserve it unless you ask otherwise.

questions.prompt: Would you like these default dimensions and supports, or different ones?

options.label: Use defaults: open-top container 1 × 1 × 1 m with 0.1 m walls; ball 0.2 m diameter; fixed container and free ball, centered on the floor.
Use the same dimensions, but make both the container and ball free.
Specify different dimensions or support choices.

message: Please choose an option or provide your preferred dimensions and whether the container should be fixed.
